messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty triggered — Incident INC-2026-482: regional GPU pressure (us-west-2). Autoscaler oscillation causing evictions and latency spikes. Severity: P1. On-call: jordan_oncall. Bridge: https://meet.example/INC-2026-482

jordan_oncall: ack, joining bridge now. pulling logs and metrics.

maya_sre: seeing repeated preemptions on g4dn pools, KV-cache churn high. top symptoms: 95th latency +3x, token throughput down ~40%.

sanjay_infra: autoscaler is reacting to short-lived QPS spikes from a batch embed job — scale_up then immediate scale_down. cooldown is 60s, we should bump.

jordan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase cooldown to 300s for us-west GPU pools 2) divert non-critical traffic to eu-fallback 3) apply CPU-fallback for low-priority queues. executing now.

ops_kim: created PR to runbook: https://git.example/r/runbooks/compare/eviction-stabilize ; also opened JIRA INF-6789 to track permanent fix.

jordan_oncall: ran command to update cooldown:
```bash
redwoodctl pools update --region=us-west-2 --pool=gpu-spot --scaling.cooldown=300
```

incident-bot: Automated rollback of scaling changes detected earlier — noting as noisy signal in the timeline.

elaine_support: Customer impact: two Dedicated customers (Acct: AcmeCorp, BetaApps) reported increased 500s and response time > 10s for embeddings endpoints between 2432109800-2432110200. CS has opened support threads.

cust_success_lee: I messaged AcmeCorp and BetaApps with a quick note and ETA for follow-up. They asked for root cause and whether fallback to EU will affect data residency.

rafael_pm: we need a post-incident review. Proposed slot: Thursday 09:00 PST. Agenda: timeline, root cause (autoscaler stability + bursty batch job), short-term mitigations, rollout of runbook change, SLA/customer communications. :calendar:

ops_kim: assigned JIRA INF-6789 (owner: sanjay_infra) and action INF-6790 for runbook PR merge (owner: ops_kim).

sanjay_infra: I'll own the autoscaler tuning work and follow-up with a canary in staging. Plan: increase default cooldown, add rate-limiting on scale events, and emit a new metric for scale_throttle.

maya_sre: action for infra + runtime: add prefix KV-cache retention guard to prevent hot-kv eviction during scale events. Owner: maya_sre.

jordan_oncall: Confirming mitigation applied and latencies recovering. Will monitor for 30m, then demobilize bridge if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Timeline note: incident opened 2432109876, mitigation applied 2432110200, partial recovery observed 2432110800.

rafael_pm: postmortem invite sent to incident participants and stakeholders. Please add any follow-ups to INF-6789 and tag owners.

elaine_support: I'll prepare a customer-facing summary for AcmeCorp and BetaApps postmortem — to be reviewed by ops and legal.

jordan_oncall: final: bridge standing down if no regressions by 2432111400. Otherwise we'll escalate. Thanks all for rapid response. :pray:
